mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the append-only fact lets two distinct AuditEntry atoms share the same Operation, which is exactly the duplication/overwrite scenario the AppendOnly pattern is meant to forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj a1, a2: AuditEntry | a1.op = a2.op }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the auth-boundary fact allows an unauthenticated Operation to still return a record, which is the precise FR-001 / SC-004 violation the assertion is supposed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthRecordReturn { some op: Operation | op.authenticated = BFalse and op.recordReturned = BTrue }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing care-team gating permits a clinician without an Active CareTeamMembership to receive a Permitted LookupRecord outcome — exactly the FR-006 / SC-010 breach.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoCareTeamPermitted { some op: Operation | op.kind = LookupRecord and op.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = op.caller and m.patient = op.presentedPatient and m.status = Active) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the no-leakage fact lets a Denied operation still return record content, distinguishing 'denied' from 'not found' to the caller — the SC-003 / FR-007 byte-equivalence violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakOnDenied { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Denied and op.recordReturned = BTrue }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the audit-existence fact, an authenticated LookupRecord operation can run without producing any AuditEntry, breaking FR-008 always-on auditing and the FR-013 'no record without audit' invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LookupWithoutAudit { some op: Operation | op.authenticated = BTrue and op.kind = LookupRecord and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.op = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the attribution fact allows an AuditEntry whose snapshotted role disagrees with the operation's actual caller-role — direct FR-009 misattribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedAudit { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.roleSnapshot != ae.op.caller.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the least-privilege fact lets an Operation with a (role, kind) pair outside the permission matrix still yield a Permitted outcome — e.g., an AuditOfficer successfully reading a patient record.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeBreach { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Permitted and op.caller.role -> op.kind not in PermMatrix.Allowed }
